corrections.reason: The preposition በ- in በየብስ ('on dry land', parallel to በባሕር ፡ በዕፀዋት) was misread as ብ due to a slight ink smudge on the left leg of በ.
In Revelation 7:4, the Ge'ez text reads ዐሠርቱ ፡ ወአርባዕቱ ፡ አልፍ ('fourteen myriad / 140,000'). The initial ዐ at the end of line 5 was misread as በ.

corrections.old_text: ስተ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ስምዖን ፡ ፬ ፡ ወ፳፻ ፡ ወእለ ፡ እምውስተ፡
corrections.corrected_text: ስተ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ስምዖን ፡ ፼ ፡ ወ፳፻ ፡ ወእለ ፡ እምውስተ፡
corrections.reason: To fit the line, the typesetter abbreviated አልፍ ፡ ወዕሥራ ፡ ምእት (12,000) with Ethiopic numerals ፼ ፡ ወ፳፻. Stage 1 misread ፼ as ፬.
